description: Official 2021 edition of AI — Here for Good: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy for Ireland (AI — Here for Good: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy for Ireland (2021)), published by National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) & Government of Ireland (ncsc.gov.ie).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) & Government of Ireland (ncsc.gov.ie) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
